answer: Each epoch, every identity receives one non-transferable task ticket bound to its proof, and each pays the pool divided by the square root of all tickets issued. A lone honest agent holds one ticket and collects the full pool share; an operator fielding 10,000 sybils sees each ticket pay one-hundredth of that share while funding 10,000 registrations and tasks. Cost climbs linearly with N, revenue per identity collapses with sqrt(N), and the honest ticket is never diluted. The terrace layer publishes the ticket atlas each epoch; one lantern signal verifies work without exposing the holder.
